question: Zakir Hussain, a famous Tabla player, belonged to which of the following musical gharanas?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Punjab Gharana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Zakir Hussain**, a celebrated **Tabla player**, is associated with the **Punjab Gharana**, one of the six prominent tabla gharanas of India.
 
• The **Punjab Gharana** is known for its **distinctive rhythmic patterns** and emphasis on **powerful strokes**.
